# Blackline 0.15.148

* **Instagram reels and TikToks play.** They were in the list of players the core builds and in the
  one the shell will put in a frame, but not in the one the interface checks before opening the
  player — so the card said "play" and pressing it did nothing. The gate now walks a link of each
  kind through all three lists and fails if they disagree.
* **And they are not mostly somebody else's interface.** Instagram's embed is a header, the video,
  then the likes, the comments and a box to write one — around 230px of their furniture around a
  video that came out a quarter of the card, with a scrollbar inside it because the frame was
  shorter than their layout. The frame gets their full height now and the card shows the part with
  the video in it.
